content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

The landscape of digital commerce is changing rapidly, especially for creators in regions underserved by conventional payment processors. COREMERCH offers a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows creators to sell digital products directly to customers without relying on platforms like PayPal or Stripe. This independence is critical as these platforms often impose high fees and stringent regulations that can stifle growth. For instance, Gumroad charges a steep 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only takes 0.5%. This difference means that for creators making 100 sales of a $97 product each month, they could retain an additional $921 by switching to a no-KYC payment solution. Understanding this framework is essential for any digital creator looking to maximize their revenue and maintain control over their business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The COREMERCH architecture is designed to be robust yet accessible, leveraging free tools to create a seamless sales experience. At its core, the infrastructure uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, providing a reliable platform for product display. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle order processing and delivery, ensuring that digital products reach customers automatically upon payment confirmation. Using NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees and no buyer account required, streamlining the payment process. This architecture not only reduces dependency on traditional payment processors but also enhances the overall efficiency of a digital store, enabling creators to focus on their craft.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH's infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators operating in regions where traditional payment platforms are either unavailable or impose high fees. This includes artists, educators, and entrepreneurs in countries like Ghana, Kenya, and Pakistan. The solution caters to those who sell a variety of digital products, such as ebooks, courses, templates, and plugins. By utilizing this infrastructure, these creators gain full control over their sales process, ensuring that they can reach their audience without the restrictions imposed by conventional platforms. The freedom to operate independently is essential for fostering creativity and entrepreneurship, allowing creators to thrive in their respective fields.
Gumroad's 10% fee can significantly impact your earnings — choose NOWPayments for just 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The COREMERCH stack comprises several key components that work in harmony to create a fully functional digital store. Starting with hosting, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serves as the foundation. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage backend operations, processing orders and facilitating product delivery. For data storage, solutions like Supabase or Google Sheets ensure that order information is securely managed. File delivery is handled via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, guaranteeing that customers receive their digital products immediately after purchase. Finally, NOWPayments integrates seamlessly to handle crypto transactions, allowing for a smooth payment experience with low fees and no KYC requirements. Together, these components create an efficient, sovereign digital commerce environment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To set up your own digital product store using COREMERCH's architecture, start by selecting your preferred hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for your backend logic. After that, choose a data storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets to keep track of your orders. For product delivery, set up either Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure quick access for your customers. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions, and you're ready to launch. By following these steps, you'll create a fully functional digital store that operates independently of conventional payment platforms. For a comprehensive resource, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for building your sovereign commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack. This infrastructure allows you to host your store on platforms like GitHub Pages, use automated delivery systems, and accept payments through NOWPayments, which supports multiple cryptocurrencies with low fees and no KYC requirements. This ensures you maintain control over your sales while maximizing earnings.
Ownership of your digital store means complete control over your sales and customer data.

This kit provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to set up your sovereign digital commerce stack without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. Check out more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
